H-Algo-1.name: Online Oja Principal-Axis Donor Splitting
H-Algo-1.mechanism: Track per-cluster top covariance eigenvector v_1(Sigma_j) and principal std sigma_{j,1} via O(B*d) batch Krasulina/Oja power iteration on residuals (x_i - c_{a(i)}), splitting donors additively along +- eta * sigma_{j,1} * v_1 rather than fixed multiplicative checkerboard [1 +- 1e-4].
H-Algo-1.equation: g_j = (1/n_j) sum_{x_i in B_j} <r_i, p_hat_j> r_i; c_donor^+- = c_j +- eta_split * sqrt(<g_j, p_hat_j>) * p_hat_j
H-Algo-1.predicted_win_regime: Clustered mixtures (GMM, Zipf GMM, Multi-Scale) and anisotropic stretched Gaussians in moderate-to-high dimension (d >= 64) when dead-cluster revivals occur (especially random-init e-means and imbalanced regimes), plus GPU BF16 runs where 1e-4 checkerboard perturbations collapse to coordinate-0 ULP nudges.
H-Algo-1.predicted_fail_regime: Isotropic uniform/Gaussian clouds (all eigenvalues equal) or warm-started e-means++ runs on balanced well-separated clusters where zero splits trigger.
H-Algo-1.falsification_criterion: Falsified if paired multi-seed train/test MSE delta against checkerboard splitting has Wilcoxon / paired-t p >= 0.05 or mean delta >= 0 across clustered and anisotropic benchmarks where splits > 0.

H-Algo-2.name: Annealed Hartigan Marginal Distortion Assignment
H-Algo-2.mechanism: Weight candidate squared distances by Hartigan-Wong's exact 1-point marginal SSE factor n_hat_j / (n_hat_j + beta(t)) using online usage-calibrated cluster counts n_hat_j = n * N_j / sum_m N_m, annealing beta(t) -> 0 before closing.
H-Algo-2.equation: a(x) = argmin_j [ (n_hat_j / (n_hat_j + beta(t))) * ||x - c_j||_2^2 ], beta(t) = beta_0 * 0.5 * (1 + cos(pi * t / t_stop))
H-Algo-2.predicted_win_regime: Small points-per-cluster regimes (n/k in [16, 128]) and unequal cluster size distributions (Zipf GMM, Multi-Scale) where finite-sample centroid recoil 1/(n_j + 1) creates circlonoi boundaries escaping Voronoi traps.
H-Algo-2.predicted_fail_regime: Large n/k >= 500 (where n_j/(n_j + 1) -> 1 within <0.2%) or high-dimensional diffuse noise where pulling boundary points into sparse clusters inflates small-cluster estimation variance.
H-Algo-2.falsification_criterion: Falsified if paired multi-seed train or test MSE in n/k in [16, 128] fails to improve significantly (p >= 0.05) or degrades out-of-sample test MSE.

H-Algo-3.name: Coherence-Gated Nesterov Centroid Lookahead EMA
H-Algo-3.mechanism: Assign points against Nesterov-extrapolated centroids c_j + mu(t) * v_j where velocity v_j tracks EMA centroid drift gated by cosine directional coherence max(0, cos(v_j^(t-1), Delta c_j^(t))), preserving exact convex-hull EMA state.
H-Algo-3.equation: c_tilde_j^(t) = c_j^(t) + mu(t) * v_j^(t); v_j^(t) = cos_+(v_j^(t-1), Delta c_j^(t)) * (beta_v v_j^(t-1) + (1 - beta_v) Delta c_j^(t))
H-Algo-3.predicted_win_regime: Ultra-low epoch budgets (T in {1, 2}) with trailing EMA lag (random init or moderate step sizes alpha_0 < 0.6), where centroids undergo coherent ballistic drift.
H-Algo-3.predicted_fail_regime: Warm-started Voronoi-polished e-means++ at T >= 5 (centroids start near local means at step 0, leaving little ballistic drift) or alpha_0 ~ 1 regimes where extrapolation overshoots.
H-Algo-3.falsification_criterion: Falsified if paired multi-seed train/test MSE at T <= 2 shows no statistically significant improvement (p >= 0.05) or degrades MSE via overshoot.

H-Algo-4.name: Scale-Invariant Top-2 Power-Mean Soft EMA Warmup
H-Algo-4.mechanism: Share mini-batch EMA mass across each point's top-2 nearest centroids during the first rho_warm fraction of steps using Xu & Lange (2019) Power-k-Means MM weights w_2 / w_1 = ((d_1^2 + eps)/(d_2^2 + eps))^(1 - s(t)) as s(t) -> -inf.
H-Algo-4.predicted_win_regime: Clustered / multimodal / multi-scale geometries with saddle barriers between modes where nearby centroids benefit from cross-boundary attraction early on.
H-Algo-4.predicted_fail_regime: High-dimensional continuous or isotropic distributions where boundary sharing contracts neighboring centroids inward toward each other (soft-quantization bias).
H-Algo-4.falsification_criterion: Falsified if top-2 power-mean warmup fails to lower final hard-Voronoi MSE (p >= 0.05) or increases MSE due to inward centroid contraction.

H-Algo-5.name: Empirical-Bayes / James-Stein Variance-Shrinkage Finalization
H-Algo-5.mechanism: Interpolate per-cluster closing_mean and slow_ema via Empirical-Bayes precision weights lambda_j = n_j / (n_j + kappa_j), trusting exact closing_mean on populous clusters while shrinking noisy small-n_j clusters toward slow_ema.
H-Algo-5.equation: c_hat_j = lambda_j * mu_close_j + (1 - lambda_j) * mu_slow_j, lambda_j = n_j / (n_j + kappa_j), kappa_j = ((d-2)/d) * sigma_hat_j^2 / tau_hat^2
H-Algo-5.predicted_win_regime: Moderate-to-small n/k (n/k in [16, 128]), high-dimensional embeddings, and Zipf/imbalanced clusterings where closing_mean suffers 1/n_j test-MSE variance on tail clusters while slow_ema suffers lag bias on large clusters.
H-Algo-5.predicted_fail_regime: Very large n/k >= 1000 with uniform cluster sizes where n_j >> kappa_j for all clusters so lambda_j -> 1 and all finalizers coincide within <0.01%.
H-Algo-5.falsification_criterion: Falsified if eb_shrinkage fails to simultaneously beat closing_mean on test MSE (p < 0.05) AND beat slow_ema on train MSE (p < 0.05) in n/k <= 128 regimes.
